answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed on proven fraud. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must fund each one, so forgery stops being free and starts costing real money. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a violet dye deepening with honest work, while a sable record of past behavior follows each identity from its first jetty-side deal onward, so a fresh fake cannot borrow the trust earned by an old honest one.
